settings.title: Frequently Asked Questions
settings.text:
Discover answers to commonly asked questions and streamline your experience by finding quick solutions to your queries in our comprehensive FAQ section.

Can't find what you are looking for? We would like to chat with you.

Contact Us

settings.title: How do I make a purchase?
settings.content: Shopping at Bareeze Man is hassle-free: Use the e-store link to find what you like. Once you have found an item, choose your size, your quantity and click on the “Add to Cart” button on the product page. Review the items in your shopping bag by clicking the “Cart Icon” at the top right side of the page. You can add or remove any items before checking out. Click on “Checkout” to complete your order.

settings.title: Do I need to set up an account to place an order?
settings.content: You can shop at Bareeze Man without creating an account.

settings.title: How do I create an account at Bareeze Man?
settings.content: Simply begin by clicking the “Sign Up” button and fill in a short relevant detailed form, with all your particulars. Please note that fields accompanied with an asterisk (*) are mandatory to fill out. Once you have created an account, you can simply log on to the site & “Sign In”

settings.title: How do I edit my details once I have made my account?
settings.content: You can edit the details which you have provided to us while making the account simply by clicking on the “My Account” tab. You can change your billing and shipping address, phone number and any other related information you feel the need the to edit.

settings.title: Is my personal information kept private?
settings.content: Please be rest assured that your personal information is kept private and confidential, and at no point will it be shared with a third party. For more information, please read our “Privacy Policy” in full detail.

settings.title: I've forgotten my password. What should I do?
settings.content: To reset your password, follow the “Forgotten Password” instructions on the “Sign In” page. Please note, for security reasons we are unable to send your old password via email.

settings.title: What payment methods does Bareeze Man accept and is it safe to use my credit card online?
settings.content:
Currently, the following payment methods are accepted: Cash on Delivery and Online Transaction (Pre-paid Options).

1. Cash on Delivery: The first option is available for all our customers throughout, Pakistan. Using this option, you can pay cash to the delivery agent upon receipt of your order. Please ensure that you have the exact amount at hand since our delivery agents do not carry change/petty cash.

2. Prepaid options: The second option is available for all our customers, globally.

settings.title: How can I choose the currency I pay in?
settings.content: Currently, if you are ordering from within Pakistan you can order in Pakistani Rupees. When you’re ordering from outside of Pakistan, you can pay in US Dollars, Dirham and Pounds.

settings.title: How long does delivery take and how much will it cost?
settings.content: We deliver online orders for “Ready to Wear” in 3-5 working days in Pakistan. There are no shipping charges applicable.

settings.title: Do you offer same day delivery?
settings.content: Currently, we do not offer same day delivery.

settings.title: Why did the product in my shopping bag disappear?
settings.content: Please bear in mind that even though you have placed an item in your “Shopping Bag”, it does not count as a purchase. It is possible that someone else checked out the item while it was in your “Shopping Bag” and the product is now out of stock. If that is the case, then you can simply come back to the site and place a new order when the product is available again.

settings.title: Is my package insured and do I need to sign for my order?
settings.content: All your purchases are insured against theft and accidental damage whilst in transit from Bareeze Man to your shipping address. Once your package has been delivered and signed for at your specified address, it is no longer covered. To ensure that your purchases arrive safely and in perfect condition, we require proof of delivery for all orders and are unable to authorize for packages to be delivered without a signature.

settings.title: How much duties and taxes will I have to pay?
settings.content: You do not have to pay any duties or taxes (except the inclusive Sales tax) when you purchase a product from Bareeze Man, because we offer free shipping and do not charge any additional costs to our customers for all local orders. International orders” shipping will be charged according to the required location.

settings.title: Does Bareezé ship to multiple addresses?
settings.content: We are only able to deliver to one address per order. If you would like to send your purchases to multiple addresses, we suggest that you place a separate order for each destination.

settings.title: Can I change or cancel my order once it has been placed?
settings.content: Before your purchases have been prepared for dispatch we can cancel an item, change the size or edit your billing and shipping details. Online payment based orders can only be cancelled within a week once placed. Please note that, we’ll be unable to combine orders or add pieces to an existing order once it has been placed.

settings.title: How can I track my order?
settings.content: As soon as your order is placed, you will be emailed an Order ID, along with your Order Confirmation. This is what will help you track your order(s). You can also check this ID when you sign in to the website. If you’re not a preferred customer, you may call or email our “Customer Care Services” with the tracking number information to find out the status of your order.

settings.title: How do I return or exchange an item?
settings.content: We do not have any exchange policy or return policy under normal circumstances. In the rare case that a faulty, damaged or incomplete item was delivered to you, you can contact our customer service. Customers can exchange their order for a different product or avail the option of Online Store Credit for the same amount (minus shipping costs), in case they wish to return a product.

settings.title: Will I be refunded the full value of my order?
settings.content: We do not offer any refunds. We do, however, give online store credit of equal value, which you can use to shop for something else at a later date. Please not that this is only applicable if you return the item within 7 days and it is not inclusive of shipping costs.

settings.title: There is a fault with the product. What do I do?
settings.content: In the rare case that a faulty, damaged or incomplete item was delivered to you, you can contact our customer service. Customers can exchange their order for a different product or avail the option of Online Store Credit for the same amount (minus shipping costs), in case they wish to return a product.

settings.title: How do I buy a gift card?
settings.content: Bareeze Man, currently does not offer any Gift Card/Loyalty Card program.
